messages:
alex: FYI PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4321 is blocked on arch sign-off. The change touches routing/caching; we need RFC confirmation before merge. RFC: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/rfc-2025-inference-routing.md

maria: quick q — is the gate for the RFC content itself or just a short acknowledgment that the approach is OK?

alex: it's the RFC content. We changed fallback semantics and KV cache invalidation behavior; that has infra/runtime implications. Per process, PR can’t merge until RFC shows explicit rollout + fallback policy.

jon: can you paste the exact lines that changed the semantics? I saw a failing unit test locally for kv-cache. Might be related.

alex: the main behavioral diff is in runtime/router.go (prefetch vs. lazy cache). Small snippet in PR description. Also CI shows the kv-cache test failing — probably why you saw it.

priya: I can review the RFC this afternoon. If we add a clear canary plan + metric guardrails (latency 99p, error rate), I think sign-off is straightforward. @jon can you triage the failing test and push a fix?

alex: thanks @priya — tagging infra and runtime reviewers too. We'll update RFC with explicit rollout steps and metric thresholds, then link back here. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: [CI] Checks failed for PR #4321 — 1 failed job: unit-tests (kv-cache). Log excerpt:
```
--- FAIL: TestKVCacheInvalidation (0.12s)
    cache_test.go:142: expected key missing after invalidation
```

jon: got it, I’ll take the failing test. Probable race in invalidation path, I can have a fix and new test by EOD.

priya: skimmed the RFC quickly. Two requests: add an explicit fallback policy table (what model variant we fall back to for each failure mode) and a short rollback checklist for private deployments. Otherwise looks good.

alex: perfect — I'll update the RFC now with both items and the canary metric gates (99p latency + error spike < 0.5% over baseline). Will post the updated link here when done. PR remains gated until RFC signoff per policy.

maria: thanks — do we have an ETA for when this can go in? Customers are waiting on the optimization.

alex: aiming EOD for RFC edits + test fix, then request a formal sign-off ping. If all goes well, merge tomorrow morning. I’ll update here when both are green.

priya: once RFC is updated, ping me and I’ll formally ack (and leave a short comment in the RFC doc).

jon: fixing test now, will push branch-4321-fix and link it here when ready.

alex: amazing, thanks everyone. Will follow up after RFC update.

maria: noted — appreciate the coordination. :clap:
